result.instructions: Tools for Chorus Pay, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the Chorus Pay orders that are still waiting for the client to accept."; "Create a quote for 7 training days for a town hall, using its SIRET."; "Cancel order ord_… because the client withdrew. The client gets an email.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Chorus Pay data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run choruspay_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run choruspay_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run choruspay_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. choruspay_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: choruspay_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (quotes) with pagination. Returns data, has_more and next_cursor. Chorus Pay API: GET /orders.

status.description: Filter by status, e.g. created, opened, accepted, invoiced, cancelled, action_required, paid.

cursor.description: Cursor from next_cursor in the previous page.

tools.name: choruspay_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id: status, client, lines, totals and the Chorus Pay link. Chorus Pay API: GET /orders/:id.

order_id.description: Order id, e.g. ord_a1b2c3d4e5f6 (from choruspay_list_orders or choruspay_create_order).

tools.name: choruspay_create_order
tools.title: Create an order quote
tools.description: Create an order (quote) with status draft. This tool does not send it to the client. Repeating the same call sends the same Idempotency-Key, so it does not create a second quote. Chorus Pay API: POST /orders.

unit_price.description: Unit price excluding VAT, at most 4 decimals.

client_info.description: Client details. When omitted, the client enters the SIRET at checkout.

siret.description: SIRET of the public body (14 digits). Chorus Pay checks it when Chorus Pro is connected.

name.description: Name of the public body. Required when siret is given.

address.description: Full address. Required when siret is given.

email.description: Contact email. Prefills the checkout; the client confirms it there.

discount_ht.description: Overall discount excluding VAT, shown as a 'Remise' line.

endpage_url.description: Redirect URL after the client accepts the quote. Defaults to your supplier setting.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. When omitted, one is derived from the request.

tools.name: choruspay_update_order
tools.title: Update an order
tools.description: Change the redirect URL and/or the metadata of an order. Metadata keys you give are added or overwritten; other keys stay. Chorus Pay API: PATCH /orders/:id.

order_id.description: Order id, e.g. ord_a1b2c3d4e5f6 (from choruspay_list_orders or choruspay_create_order).

endpage_url.description: Redirect URL after the client accepts the quote. Pass null to remove the redirect.

metadata.description: Metadata to merge into the order.

tools.name: choruspay_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: Cancel an order that is cancelled in your shop or tool. Chorus Pay emails the client. Replaying the call is safe. Fails with 409 once the invoice is filed on Chorus Pro. Chorus Pay API: POST /orders/:id/cancel.

order_id.description: Order id, e.g. ord_a1b2c3d4e5f6 (from choruspay_list_orders or choruspay_create_order).
